question: Ram is to the south-west of Abhishek. Arjun is to the north of Ram as well as to the west of Abhishek. Pooja is to the west of Arjun. What is the position of Pooja with respect to Abhishek?
solution:
**Given: **

Ram is to the south-west of Abhishek.

Arjun is to the north of Ram as well as to the west of Abhishek.

Pooja is to the west of Arjun.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52eee66b07f289f0e442311ba1a4705883ab3237e9350ab340763427e956f467.png] 

Thus, the position of Pooja with respect to Abhishek is **West**.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
